cues.en: We are fast approaching press time for the first edition of tomorrow morning's paper. This printer has just finished makeup of a page. In the next 56 minutes, all pages must be finished and recorded to meet the edition deadline of 9 p.m. But tonight's deadline is special. This New York Times mirror image and lens of tomorrow's date line reads backwards as Sunday, July 2nd, 1978.
cues.zh: 明天早报第一版的开印时间马上就要到了。这位排字工刚刚拼完一个版面。在接下来的 56 分钟里，所有版面必须全部完成并归档，以赶上晚上 9 点的截稿期。但今晚的截止时间非同寻常。《纽约时报》明天版头的镜面字反过来读，是 1978 年 7 月 2 日，星期日。

cues.en: It marks the last day of an age-old method of printing in this composing room. You are now witnessing will exist after tonight only as a film historic record, for the century of the linotype machine is nearing its end. Using 535 degree molten lead, it sets solid lines of type called hot pipe, cast in newspaper column width. Now cooled, a printer's hands prepare the lines
cues.zh: 这标志着这个排字房里古老印刷技术的最后一天。你现在看到的一切，今晚过后就只能在胶片影像中追忆了，因为 Linotype 排字机走过的百年历程正接近尾声。它使用 535 度的熔融铅水，浇铸出报纸专栏宽度的整行铅字，即所谓的“热排铅字”。待其冷却后，排字工人熟练地整理铅行，

cues.en: for insertion into a column of the page. Headlines are still set by hand with types stored in traditional California cases and in time-worn Ludlow cabinets. By morning, relics of the past. Letter by letter, the printer forms the words in his composing stick in the same way that Gutenberg, the first printer of the Western world, did more than five centuries ago. Brass molds of letters are assembled in a different composing stick.
cues.zh: 准备插入版面的栏目中。大标题依然由手工拼排，字模存放在传统的 California 字架和饱经风霜的 Ludlow 柜中。到明天早晨，它们都将沦为历史遗物。排字工在字规里逐字组词，这种方式与五个多世纪前西方首位印刷大师 Gutenberg 的做法毫无二致。而在另一种字规里，组装的则是字母铜模，

cues.en: also for headlines. Inside this Ludlow machine, which was invented a quarter of a century after the linotype, they will be cast from liquid lead to form a solid slug of type. By tomorrow, this Ludlow II will be a museum piece. These steel tables for page makeup are called printer's stones. They have been gradually abandoned over the past months. A radical changeover has taken place.
cues.zh: 同样用于制作标题。这台在 Linotype 发明 25 年后才诞生的 Ludlow 机器内部，铅水会将铜模浇铸成整块的铅字行。到了明天，这台 Ludlow 也将成为博物馆展品。这些用于拼版的钢制台面被称为“排版石台”。在过去的几个月里，它们已被陆续废弃。一场翻天覆地的转变已经发生，

cues.en: for a new era of computerized, electronic, automated, and cold-type phototechnology has begun. It started in the brightly lit area beyond these two dark hopes of discarded linotype machines. Now lined up for shipment, they have been the old reliability here for decades. Tonight, 60 of the once 140 linotypes, the largest battery of any newspaper in the world, are on their final stint.
cues.zh: 因为一个集计算机化、电子化、自动化和冷排照相排版技术的新时代已经开启。这场变革始于这片堆放废弃 Linotype 机器的阴暗区域之外、那片灯火通明的地方。如今它们整齐排列准备运离，几十年来，它们曾是这里最可靠的基石。今晚，曾经庞大至 140 台——也是全球报业最大规模机群——的 Linotype 中，仅剩的 60 台正在坚守最后的班次。

cues.en: Before the rush to addition time, a makeup man spoke to us about this machine. You know, a hundred years ago, a man named Atmar Mergenthaler invented a machine called a linotype, well known by most people. But I find that it was the automation of its day. The only thing is I think it was the machine that made mass education possible. It brought the price of books within the range of the average working person.
cues.zh: 在截稿前的紧张冲刺之前，一位拼版师傅向我们谈起了这台机器：“你知道，一百年前，一个叫 Ottmar Mergenthaler 的人发明了 Linotype 排字机，人尽皆知。但在我看来，它就是那个时代的自动化。最重要的是，我认为是它让大众教育成为了可能，它让书籍的价格降到了普通工人阶层也能承受的水平。

cues.en: This is the machine over here, and it's practically unchanged in a hundred years. I feel if old man, Mergentola, came back, he could probably go over to that machine, sit down, and set up a couple of galleys of type without any problems at all. If there were any problems as far as fixing the machine, I'm sure he could get up and fix it. But that's how long that machine has lasted a hundred years. It all begins with this machine. Really, three machines in one. Assembly, casting, and redistribution.
cues.zh: 这就是那台机器，一百年来几乎未曾改变。我觉得如果 Mergenthaler 老爷子能重返人间，他大概能径直走过去，坐下，顺顺当当地排上几栏铅字。如果机器出了什么毛病，我相信他也能随手修好。这就是这台机器的历史，整整一百年。一切都始于这台机器。确切地说，它是‘三机合一’：组模、浇铸和分拣归位。”

cues.en: In this portion of the machine, we keep these brass mattresses, which have a letter punched into their edge. In this case, the letter M. When I press a key, these mattresses will fall along this gravity chute and into the assembler. If I press this M, you'll see that M come down. There it is. Now when I want to space a word, I'll drop in a space band, which is a steel wedge.
cues.zh: 在这台机器的这个部位，存放着这些铜字模，它们的边缘压印有字母。这里是一个字母 M。当我按下一个键时，这些字模就会顺着重力滑槽落入组字器中。如果我按下这个 M，你就会看到 M 落下来。瞧，落下来了。现在，当我要在词之间留出空格时，就会落入一个空格楔，它是一个钢楔。

cues.en: It slides up and down and spreads the line to the exact size that I want in a column so that every line is exactly equal to the other in width. When we send a line into the casting machine, this is what happens. If we take these mattresses, they'll come down and face against this steel mold. Hot metal molten lead will be poured into that steel mold. This mattress will be faced against here with the mold of the mattress against the top.
cues.zh: 它会上下滑动，将这行字撑开到分栏所需的精确宽度，使每一行的宽度都完全一致。当我们把排好的一行送进铸字机时，就会发生这样的过程。这些字模会落下来，贴合在钢模具前。滚烫的铅液会被注入钢模中。字模贴在这里，字模上的字型朝向顶部。

cues.en: The lead will harden and pick up the image from the inside of this mold and this mattress. It will turn around through here, it will harden, it will be trimmed, and it will be ejected right here. Now let's watch a line go in. This one is just about ready. Going across now. The bands are spreading the line out now. The line is being pumped in, the hot lead is hardening now, it's being trimmed, and here's your new line of type. But the real machine is in the back.
cues.zh: 铅液会凝固并复刻模具和字模内部的字形。它会从这里转过来，冷却凝固、被修整切平，然后直接从这里推出。现在我们来看看一行字模送进去的过程。这一行快准备好了。正在送过去。空格楔正在撑开这行字。铅液正被压注进去，滚烫的铅液正在凝固、被切平，看，这就是铸好的新铅字行。但真正的机械核心在后面。

cues.en: It was a watchmaker who invented it. This uniquely shaped eccentric cam is the heart of his entire system. As it rotates, it programs all the intricate operations of this automatic producer of type for the composing of the paper. It makes the linotype machine run like a huge wound up clock, ticking with perfect precision. In the meantime, these mattresses have been redistributed and transferred into those
cues.zh: 发明它的是一位钟表匠。这个形状独特的偏心凸轮是他整套系统的核心。随着它的旋转，它调度着这台自动排字机所有复杂的工序，为报纸排版铸字。它让这台 Linotype 排字机像上足了发条的巨型钟表一样运转，分毫不差，精准滴答。与此同时，这些字模已经被分拣并送回那些

cues.en: magazines, and we can use them again and again. This story is about finish now. We can take it over to the bank, get a galley proof, send it into the proof room for proofreading, and when we're finished with that, we'll take the type and put it either on a correction bank or maybe directly into the page and wait for the corrections. These latest machines, without keyboards, have built-in teletypesetter units. Instead of fingers on keys, perforated tape does the work.
cues.zh: 字模盒里，我们可以反复使用它们。这篇稿件马上就排完了。我们可以把它送到排字台上，打出一张活版校样，送进校对室进行校对；校对完成后，我们取出铅字，放到纠错台或者直接拼进版面，等待修正。这些最新的无键盘机器内置了电传排字机单元。不再需要手指敲键盘，而是由打孔纸带来完成工作，

cues.en: like the old music roll in the player piano. This enables one person to monitor three machines at once. A solid bar or pig of lead is lowered into the melting pot to refill at percastic. Sign language is used among the paper's many deaf printers. Instead of three lines a minute, the old manual way, each machine now sets 14 lines a minute. It's as far as mechanical automation could go in the pre-electronic age.
cues.zh: 就像自动钢琴里老式的打孔纸卷一样。这让一个人可以同时照看三台机器。一整根铅条或铅锭被降入熔铅锅，源源不断地补充铸字用铅。报社里许多听障排字工之间用手语交流。相比以往人工排字每分钟三行的速度，现在每台机器每分钟能排14行。这就是电子时代到来前，机械自动化所能达到的极致。

cues.en: Lines of type and picture cuts are made up into full-page forms guided by editor's layout sheets.
cues.zh: 按照编辑的版面编排单，铅字行与图版被拼装成整版印版。

cues.en: You want to make a box out of it and then turn this? The closest cooperation is needed between the page editor and the makeup. I got it. I got it. I got to get it back together. Together, they almost talk the type into the page form, hoax it, cajole it, to make it fit as they work against the clock. Pull the line back in price. Okay. Everyone is aware of the time. I know if I let this page go.
cues.zh: 你想把它框起来，然后再转这个吗？版面编辑和拼版工之间需要最紧密的配合。我明白了，我明白了，我得把它重新拼好。两人分秒必争，好说歹说地哄着这些铅字，硬让它们严丝合缝。把价格那行缩回来。好的。大家都清楚时间紧迫。我知道只要我把这页放行……

cues.en: Only 40 minutes are left to the 9 o'clock first edition deadline. From now on, a page a minute. 40 more pages must be completed. Locked up in these page forms and ready for the presses. Metal engravings like these are cut down to size and precisely trimmed. The cuts will print up as the drawings and photos you see in the paper every day.
cues.zh: 距离9点第一版截稿只剩40分钟。从现在起，一分钟一版。还要完成40个版面。锁入版框，准备送上印刷机。像这样的金属雕版被切割成合适尺寸并精准裁边。这些图版印出来就是大家每天在报纸上看到的插图和照片。

cues.en: The handling of type and cuts is the job of the makeup man, while the page editor indicates to him what she wants. Reading the type upside down and backwards, he sees a reverse image of what will be the final printed page, and may even catch an overlooked error.
cues.zh: 铅字和图版的排布是拼版工的职责，版面编辑则向他提出排版要求。拼版工倒着、反着阅读铅字，看到的是最终印刷版面的镜像，甚至还能揪出被遗漏的错误。

cues.en: Only 14 minutes to go. Everyone feels the urgency. Pages are nearing completion. Makeups tighten keys to bring type and cuts closely together. This keeps pieces from falling out when forms are moved off the stones. This page is about done.
cues.zh: 只剩14分钟了。人人都感到紧迫。版面接近完工。拼版工拧紧锁块钥匙，让铅字和图版紧紧咬合在一起。这样将版框从拼版石台上移开时，铅字就不会脱落。这一版差不多好了。

cues.en: Almost finished. The editor sends this one on its way. The presses are waiting. Trucks, trains, and planes must be met to rush the paper to the city, to the country, and to the world.
cues.zh: 快完工了。编辑将这一版送出。印刷机正严阵以待。报纸必须赶上卡车、火车和飞机，第一时间发往全城、全国乃至全世界。

cues.en: Now this one is on its way. And the last one to close is page one. On time. And now a work break and also a party for old-time linotype operator Albert Tengway. Over 49 years being a member of the composer room, a senior member of the priority list.
cues.zh: 现在这一版也送出了。最后定版的是头版。准时完成。接着是工休，同时也是老排字机操作员 Albert Tengway 的欢送派对。他在排字房工作了49年多，是资历名单上的元老。

cues.en: The number one man on the flight audience. How do you feel about this changeover? Well, I feel that they call it progress. I would like to stay the way they want. Keep the old machine running. How long have you worked here? One short of 49 years.
cues.zh: 名列前茅的资深员工。“你对这次技术转型有什么感受？”“嗯，我觉得大家都称之为进步。我还是想按原来的方式来，让老机器继续转下去。”“你在这里工作多久了？”“差一年就49年了。”

cues.en: This worker chalks up his sentiments. End of an error. Good while it lasted, crying won't help. I find it very sad, very sad. I've learned a new stuff, a new process, I don't know, but I didn't...
cues.zh: 这位工人用粉笔写下了自己的心声。一个时代的终结。曾经美好过，哭也没用。“我觉得非常难过，非常伤心。我学了新东西，新流程，我不知道，但我没有……”

cues.en: printing now for 26 years. I've been in this place for 20 years. Six years of apprenticeship, 20 years journeyman. And these are words that aren't just tossed around. They've always meant something to us printers. I hate to see it. It's inevitable that we're going to go into computers. All the knowledge I've acquired over these 26 years is all locked up in a little box now called a computer. And I think probably most jobs are going to end up the same way. I think computers are a good idea in general.
cues.zh: 从事印刷已经26年了。我在这里干了20年。学徒干了6年，正式工干了20年。这些词可不是随便说说的。对我们印刷工来说，它们一直意义非凡。我真不想看到这一幕。走向计算机化是不可避免的。这26年来我积累的所有知识，如今都被锁进了一个叫计算机的小盒子里。我想大多数工作可能最终都是这个下场。总的来说，我觉得计算机是个好东西。

cues.en: Oh, there's no doubt about it. They're going to benefit everybody eventually. How long it will take, I don't know. Carefully, back on the stone were changes by the news department for the second, the late city edition. A galley of new type for a late breaking story is proofed up to be read for accuracy. Corrections are checked. Lines with errors are replaced by corrected lines. And page one is ready to go again for the new deadline, 11 p.m.
cues.zh:
哦，这毫无疑问。
最终人人都会受益。
要多久，我不知道。
新闻部门为第二版——晚间城市版——所做的修改，被小心地放回拼版台。
为突发新闻新排的长条活字版已打样，供通读核对准确性。
更正内容经过检查。
有错误的行会被更正后的行替换。
第一版又准备好赶新的截稿时间——晚上11点。

cues.en: This time we follow it to the making of a stereotype mat. The mat is a damp sheet of flexible cardboard. A solid steel roller will press it against the hundreds of separate lines and picture cuts locked together in this page form. Five minutes to the 11 o'clock deadline, the stereotype taps down a spacing lid so that it won't print. The mat will soon be curved and dried into a half cylinder form. From it, curved.
cues.zh:
这次我们跟着它去看纸型的制作。
纸型是一张潮湿的可弯曲纸板。
一个实心钢辊会把它压向锁在这块版面版框里的数百条独立文字行和图片凸版。
离11点截稿还有五分钟，铸版工敲下一个间隔盖，让它不会印出来。
纸型很快会被弯曲并烘干成半圆筒形。
从它这里，铸出弯曲的。

cues.en: Solid lead plates will be cast to fit on the rotary presses. The pressure of one ton per square inch is forced upon the cardboard. The raised lead type presses into the mat, forming a mold of recessed letters. The mat is now right reading and ready for casting. All right. Down into the stereo casting room, three stories below street level in the times building. Hot lead will now pour into the recessed impressions of type in this curved mat.
cues.zh:
实心铅板将被铸造成适合轮转印刷机的形状。
每平方英寸一吨的压力被压到纸板上。
凸起的铅字压入纸型，形成凹字模。
现在纸型上的字是正向可读的，可以铸版了。
好。
下到铸版室，它在 Times 大楼街面以下三层。
热铅现在将灌入这张弯曲纸型上的凹字印模中。

cues.en: Casting starts. These mammoth machines are up for sale. Some will go under the hammer at auction. A few will be cannibalized for spare parts. Nine identical page plates, who run on nine presses at the same time, are cooled in these steel chambers before rolling into the press room. When is this operation going to close up? It's going to close up in the morning. How do you feel about it? Another innovation.
cues.zh:
铸版开始。
这些巨型机器正挂牌出售。
有些会在拍卖会上落槌。
少数会被拆掉当备件。
九块相同的版面铅版将在九台印刷机上同时运转；它们在滚入印刷车间前会先在这些钢制腔室里冷却。
这道工序什么时候结束？
早上就结束。
你对此怎么看？
又一项革新。

cues.en: I knew the new process were moving into. How do you feel about it? When I think of these machines costing over $100,000 apiece to be jumped, it kind of leaves me loose. You know, this is as far as they could go, though. As far as the automation with the hot metal is as far as the times could go. What is it going to mean to you personally? It means I'll have to learn a new process. One after another, into the press room. Warning bells ring when the presses start up. Page one, sports. These heavy plates.
cues.zh:
我知道我们正在转向新工艺。
你对此怎么看？
一想到这些每台造价超过10万美元的机器要被淘汰，我就有点没着落。
你知道，不过他们最多也只能做到这一步了。
就热铅自动化而言，Times 也只能走到这一步。
这对你个人意味着什么？
这意味着我得学一套新工艺。
一块接一块，进入印刷车间。
印刷机启动时，警铃会响。
第一版，体育版。
这些沉重的铅版。

cues.en: on their snaking and crisscrossing tracks, or making their final run to the nine presses tonight. Will the new technology, just a few hours away, make a big change down here? A pressman shrugs it off. Instead of using lead 40-pound plates and locking them up, instead of using these lead plates.
cues.zh:
沿着蜿蜒交错的轨道，或在今晚完成通往九台印刷机的最后一段行程。
几小时后就要到来的新技术，会让这里发生巨大变化吗？
一名印刷工耸耸肩，不以为然。
不再使用40磅重的铅版并把它们锁紧，不再使用这些铅版。

cues.en: What we do is use a plastic plate that only weighs a few ounces and it just goes on a cylinder and there's a magnetic bar that holds it on. So you just get the hang of putting it on, that's all. The rest of the job won't change significantly. Page one, man! Peering reached the last time that a 40-pound half-cylinder plate of lead will ever again be mounted on these presses. Scrap from the previous press run is cleared from the conveyor.
cues.zh: 我们用的是一块只有几盎司重的塑料印版，它直接装到滚筒上，由一根磁条固定。你只要学会把它装上去就行了，就这么简单。其余工作不会有太大变化。头版，老兄！我们迎来了最后一次：重达40磅的半圆柱形铅版将最后一次被装到这些印刷机上。上一次印刷留下的废料从传送带上清走。

cues.en: They carry the finished papers up to the street level above Now the last reversal from wrong reading type to the final inked right reading printed page And the presses keep rolling through the night This is goodbye Generations of line of type operators have often run their fingers down the first two rows of keys Releasing mats that read a ton should loom
cues.zh: 他们把印好的报纸送到上面的街道层。现在，从反向阅读的字型到最后印成正读的印刷页面，完成最后一次翻转。印刷机整夜不停运转。这是告别。一代代行型排字操作员常常把手指沿前两排按键滑下，释放字模，让一行行字排列成型。

cues.en: This fills out lines that start with keyboard errors. The last bad line is discarded at the end of the story. Motor off. A last touch of familiar grass mats. Light out for good. It is the end of the age of hot-type mechanical printing. And the beginning of the new. The computerized coal-type. The electronic. These seasoned printers retrained.
cues.zh: 这会补全那些因键盘输入错误而开头的行。最后一行错行在稿件结尾被丢弃。关闭电机。最后一次触摸熟悉的黄铜字模。灯光永远熄灭。这是热排机械印刷时代的终结。也是新时代的开始。计算机化冷排。电子排版。这些经验丰富的印刷工接受了再培训。

cues.en: have made the transition from the old to the new. The electronic images of letters that I have just set on this video display screen I'll now send to the computer, where it is processed, stored, and brought back when required for corrections. Back to the computer. When needed, a touch of a keep returns it to the editor. It is then changed to the desired column width, style, size of type, and hyphenation.
cues.zh: 他们完成了从旧到新的转变。我刚在这块视频显示屏上排好的字母电子图像，现在会发送到计算机，在那里处理、存储，需要修改时再调回来。回到计算机。需要时，按一下键，它就会回到编辑那里。然后按所需栏宽、样式、字号和断字方式进行修改。

cues.en: followed by further keyboarding of headlines and bylines, then to one of five photo typesetters, each an electronic mirror. Inside, a web of components and wiring does the work of 140 line of types, generating a vast array of electronic type images on a concealed capital grade tube. These images are contacted onto photosensitive paper at a thousand lines a minute, emerging from the darkroom.
cues.zh: 随后再用键盘输入标题和署名，然后送到五台照相排字机之一，每台都像一面电子镜子。内部，复杂的元件和线路完成相当于140台行型排字机的工作，在隐藏的阴极射线管上生成大量电子字型图像。这些图像以每分钟一千行的速度接触曝光到感光纸上，从暗房中输出。

cues.en: The photosensitized paper has now been transformed by a developing machine into photographic cold type, ready for full-page paste-up. This productivity leap from 14 to 1,000 lines a minute is made possible several floors above by a battery of computers. These units contain magnetized memory disks and electronic digital systems, which store and process all the data sent from below. Switches and buttons add a touch.
cues.zh: 感光纸现在经显影机变成照相冷排字，可用于整页拼版。从每分钟14行到1000行的生产率飞跃，是由楼上几层的一组计算机实现的。这些设备包含磁化存储磁盘和电子数字系统，存储并处理从楼下传来的所有数据。开关和按钮只需轻轻一按，

cues.en: bring us into an ever-advancing world of automation, computerization, and programmed electron flow. Humidity and temperature, monitored and controlled around the clock, are critical. These cabinets hold layered packs of yellow magnetic disks and others like this. The disks, in operation, spin at 140 miles an hour. More than 8 million words can be stored and sent back by each disk pack.
cues.zh: 带我们进入一个不断进步的自动化、计算机化和程序化电子流的世界。湿度和温度全天候监测和控制，至关重要。这些机柜里装着层层叠放的黄色磁盘组，以及像这样的其他设备。磁盘运行时以每小时140英里的速度旋转。每个磁盘组可存储并回送超过800万个单词。

cues.en: and cold type on paper keeps on flowing. Photo technology has conquered hot metal. The typeset paper is cut, waxed on the back for adhesion, and pasted up on full page boards on these tables. That'll bring the type down to here. It's gonna be a new type here. Yes, right. That's gonna go deeper? Mm-hmm. Okay. Core. Right. That's holding it. Thank you, Jack. From obituaries to sports.
cues.zh: 纸上的冷排文字源源不断地产出。照相排版技术已经取代了热金属铅字。排好版的相纸被裁切下来，背面涂蜡以便粘贴，然后在这些工作台上拼贴成整版。这样文字就一直排到这里了。这里要用一种新字体。对，没错。还要往里放一点吗？嗯哼。好的。核心版块。对。固定住了。谢谢你，Jack。从讣告到体育，

cues.en: to the worlds of business, entertainment, real estate, classified and display advertising, and of course, the news. These color patches will soon be replaced by headlines. They are now being cut to exact size. No more molten lead. He has made it from hot type makeup to cold type paste up. The last headline in place. Ready to go. Page one.
cues.zh: 再到商业、娱乐、房地产、分类广告与展示广告，当然还有各类新闻。这些色块很快就会被大标题替换。现在正将它们裁切成精确的尺寸。不再需要滚烫的熔铅了。他已经成功从热排组版转向了冷排拼版。最后一条大标题就位。准备就绪。第一版

cues.en: will now be transferred electronically through impulses from this laser scanner machine to the plate room underground. In a moment, the laser beam within will scan the pasted-up page. This will result in 14-ounce flexible plastic plates made and used down below in the press room. Page after page will be run off on the high-speed rotary presses as before and folded into the finished paper. But despite automation,
cues.zh: 现在将通过这台激光扫描机的电脉冲，以电子方式传输到地下的制版室。稍后，机器内部的激光束就会扫描拼贴好的版面。从而制作出14盎司的柔性塑料印版，供楼下的印刷车间使用。一页又一页的报纸将像往常一样在高速轮转机上印出，并折叠成成品报纸。但尽管有了自动化、

cues.en: computerization, and the continuing advances of electronics, the central factor is still the work of the human brain, the work of human eyes, and the work of human hands in creating that powerful element of communication, a printed word.
cues.zh: 计算机化以及电子技术的不断进步，最核心的要素依然是人类的大脑、双眼与双手，正是它们创造出了这一强大的信息传播载体——印刷文字。
